d: Dog and the team track two fugitives who have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake; Dog tries to convince the women to help him track down their men.
Dog's longtime friend and fellow bondsman, Jim, has a son who has just started in the family business; Dog takes Jim's son along for some training as he tracks down a potentially dangerous fugitive.
Dog and his team head to Colorado to catch a drug dealer, who has been on the run for 10 months and whose bondsman stands to lose the family business.
Dog and his posse scheme to catch an alleged drug dealer with a big bond by using a fellow fugitive as bait.
Dog continues to pursue Marco across Colorado; a tip sends Dog and his team racing south to Pueblo looking for a longtime associate of Marco's.
Dog and the posse help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple who allegedly stole a pair of Buddha statues.
Dog and his team have a hard time pinning down a fugitive in Honolulu's downtown district; Dog discovers that the fugitive is not the only family member wanted by the law.
A stripper goes on the lam, and Dog is the one who has to bring her in; lady luck presides over the crew.
The Chapman clan tries to balance the demands of the job with preparations for Baby Lyssa's approaching wedding.

Dog and his team hunt a target with a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving that resonates on the anniversary of the fatal vehicular accident that claimed the life of the bounty hunter's daughter, Barbara Katie.
Dog and his team track a fugitive, with a bad reputation and a knack for eluding the law, to try to put him behind bars.
What seems like a routine pickup turns into a complicated case of betrayal, deceit and nail care as Dog and company hunt a fugitive alleged to be an abusive boyfriend.
The Chapmans prepare for a family gathering to celebrate the holiday season and members of the posse reflect on their highlights from bounty hunting.
